package timergate

import (
    "fmt"
    "runtime"
    "testing"
    "unsafe"
)

type unit struct{}
type lsfTimerSlot struct { token [2]uint64; weak unsafe.Pointer; callback bool }
type lsfTokenResult struct { tag, padding uint32; generation, id uint64 }
type lsfUnitResult struct { tag, failure byte }
type timer struct { isChan bool; lsfToken [2]uint64; lsfSlot uint32; lsfGate chan struct{}; active bool; period int64 }
type timeTimer struct { timer; isFake bool }
type g struct { lsfOwner [2]uint64; bubble *byte }
type lsfTimerWait struct { token [2]uint64; stopped bool; done chan unit }
type taskState struct { timerWaits []*lsfTimerWait }
var state *taskState
var lsfTimerSlots []lsfTimerSlot
var lsfTimerCallbacks uint32
var lsfTimerParent [2]uint64
var lsfActivationActive = true
var currentG = g{lsfOwner: [2]uint64{8,88}}
var raceenabled = false
var lastID uint64
var hostOwners map[[2]uint64]bool
var retiredOld chan struct{}
var enteredFence chan struct{}
var resetHook func(*timer)
func getg() *g { return &currentG }
func nanotime() int64 { return 100 }
func racerelease(unsafe.Pointer) {}
func fatal(s string) { panic(s) }
func lsfFail(s string) { panic(s) }
func lsfMaybeWakeTimerDrain() {}
func controlledFenceReceive(wait *lsfTimerWait) { close(enteredFence); <-wait.done }
func (t *timer) stop() bool { previous := t.active; t.active=false; return previous }
func (t *timer) reset(_, period int64) bool {
    previous:=t.active; t.active=true; t.period=period
    hook:=resetHook;resetHook=nil;if hook!=nil { hook(t) };return previous
}
func internal_weak_runtime_registerWeakPointer(p unsafe.Pointer) unsafe.Pointer { return p }
func internal_weak_runtime_makeStrongFromWeak(p unsafe.Pointer) unsafe.Pointer { return p }
func lsfTimerStart(_ int64, _ int32, _ int64, _ int32, _, _ int64, result unsafe.Pointer) {
    lastID++;token:=[2]uint64{7,lastID};hostOwners[token]=true
    *(*lsfTokenResult)(result)=lsfTokenResult{generation:token[0],id:token[1]}
}
func lsfTimerStop(generation,id int64,result unsafe.Pointer) {
    token:=[2]uint64{uint64(generation),uint64(id)}
    if !hostOwners[token] { panic(fmt.Sprint("unknown original owner ",token)) }
    delete(hostOwners,token);*(*lsfUnitResult)(result)=lsfUnitResult{}
    if retiredOld!=nil && token==[2]uint64{7,1} { retiredOld<-struct{}{} }
}
func fixture() (*timeTimer,*lsfTimerWait) {
    runtime.GOMAXPROCS(1);lsfTimerSlots=nil;lsfTimerCallbacks=0;lastID=1;resetHook=nil
    hostOwners=map[[2]uint64]bool{{7,1}:true}
    current:=&timeTimer{timer:timer{isChan:true,active:true,lsfGate:make(chan struct{},1)}}
    current.lsfGate<-struct{}{};lsfInstallTimer(&current.timer,[2]uint64{7,1})
    wait:=&lsfTimerWait{token:[2]uint64{7,1},done:make(chan unit)}
    state=&taskState{timerWaits:[]*lsfTimerWait{wait}};enteredFence=make(chan struct{});retiredOld=make(chan struct{},1)
    return current,wait
}
func startFirst(t *testing.T,current *timeTimer,wait *lsfTimerWait,operation string) <-chan bool {
    t.Helper();done:=make(chan bool,1)
    go func(){ if operation=="reset" { done<-resetTimer(current,200,0) } else { done<-stopTimer(current) } }()
    <-enteredFence
    if !wait.stopped || current.lsfToken != [2]uint64{} { t.Fatal("first operation did not reach old-token fence") }
    select { case <-done:t.Fatal("first operation escaped the old-token fence");default: }
    return done
}
func startSecond(t *testing.T,current *timeTimer,operation string) <-chan bool {
    t.Helper();started:=make(chan struct{});done:=make(chan bool,1)
    go func(){ close(started);if operation=="reset" { done<-resetTimer(current,300,0) } else { done<-stopTimer(current) } }()
    <-started;runtime.Gosched();select { case <-done:t.Fatal("second operation escaped held gate");default: };return done
}
func expectOwners(t *testing.T,current *timeTimer,count int,active bool) {
    t.Helper();slots:=0;for _,slot:=range lsfTimerSlots { if slot.token[1]!=0 { slots++ } }
    if len(hostOwners)!=count || slots!=count || current.active!=active || (count==1 && !hostOwners[current.lsfToken]) {
        t.Fatalf("owners=%v slots=%d token=%v active=%v",hostOwners,slots,current.lsfToken,current.active)
    }
}
func TestResetResetSerializesAndKeepsBothTrue(t *testing.T) {
    current,wait:=fixture();first:=startFirst(t,current,wait,"reset");second:=startSecond(t,current,"reset")
    close(wait.done);a,b:=<-first,<-second;if !a || !b { t.Fatalf("first=%v second=%v",a,b) };expectOwners(t,current,1,true)
}
func TestResetStopSerializesAndLeavesStopped(t *testing.T) {
    current,wait:=fixture();first:=startFirst(t,current,wait,"reset");second:=startSecond(t,current,"stop")
    close(wait.done);a,b:=<-first,<-second;if !a || !b { t.Fatalf("reset=%v stop=%v",a,b) };expectOwners(t,current,0,false)
}
func TestStopResetSerializesAndReturnsFalseForReset(t *testing.T) {
    current,wait:=fixture();first:=startFirst(t,current,wait,"stop");second:=startSecond(t,current,"reset")
    close(wait.done);a,b:=<-first,<-second;if !a || b { t.Fatalf("stop=%v reset=%v",a,b) };expectOwners(t,current,1,true)
}
func TestStopStopSerializesAndSecondIsFalse(t *testing.T) {
    current,wait:=fixture();first:=startFirst(t,current,wait,"stop");second:=startSecond(t,current,"stop")
    close(wait.done);a,b:=<-first,<-second;if !a || b { t.Fatalf("first=%v second=%v",a,b) };expectOwners(t,current,0,false)
}
func TestOneShotCallbackMayRetireWithoutTakingGate(t *testing.T) {
    current,wait:=fixture();installed:=make(chan struct{},1);resume:=make(chan struct{})
    resetHook=func(*timer){ installed<-struct{}{};<-resume }
    first:=startFirst(t,current,wait,"reset");close(wait.done);<-installed
    second:=startSecond(t,current,"reset")
    current.active=false // Simulate Go's one-shot when=0 before invoking the g0 callback.
    lsfBeforeTimerCallback(&current.timer);lsfAfterTimerCallback(&current.timer)
    expectOwners(t,current,0,false);close(resume)
    a,b:=<-first,<-second;if !a || b { t.Fatalf("first=%v second=%v",a,b) };expectOwners(t,current,1,true)
}
func TestRecoverablePanicReleasesGateForFollowingStop(t *testing.T) {
    current,wait:=fixture();resetHook=func(*timer){panic("modeled panic")};done:=make(chan interface{},1)
    go func(){defer func(){done<-recover()}();resetTimer(current,200,0)}()
    <-enteredFence;close(wait.done)
    if result:=<-done;result!="modeled panic" { t.Fatal(result) }
    if !stopTimer(current) { t.Fatal("remaining model timer was not active") };expectOwners(t,current,0,false)
}
